attributes.nuance_translation: A common way to express an approximation or extent.

attributes.body:
くらい or ぐらい (more common in spoken language) has several different uses in Japanese, but is often translated as 'about', or 'approximately'. It comes from the kanji 位（くらい）, which literally means a 'rank', or 'grade' of something. This use of くらい comes after numbers, or counter words.

As can be seen in the last example, くらい may also be used after question words such as どの, when asking about the extent (grade) of something.

Due to the original meaning of くらい being 'rank', or 'extent', it may not be used when referring to broad periods of time. ころ will be used in these situations. However, くらい and ころ may be used interchangeably when referring to a specific time (due to a specific time being able to be thought of as an extent).

Caution

Please see the ころ grammar point if you would like to compare these two structures further.

attributes.source: [DBJG] A Dictionary of Basic Japanese Grammar

attributes.description: 位 = くらい・ぐらい
The Particles ほど & くらい

attributes.body: くらい (often ぐらい in speech) expresses an approximate degree or extent. It's commonly used with number + counter expressions (the くらい① form), as in 100円くらい = 'about 100 yen.' It can also be used like ほど to express extent or degree, as in 足が動けなくなるくらい走った = 'I ran so much my legs couldn't move anymore.'

second_relatable.title: くらい ②
second_relatable.meaning: To the extent that, So…that, About the only thing that...

attributes.body: くらい (or ぐらい in speech) expresses an approximate degree or amount, like the English 'about.' It's commonly used with numbers and counters (the くらい① form), e.g. 100円くらい = 'about 100 yen.' A related pattern, は～くらいです, means 'just about the only X is Y.' For example, 食べ物で嫌いなのはピーマンくらいです = 'The only food I dislike is peppers.'

second_relatable.title: は～くらいです
second_relatable.meaning: About the only, To the extent that

attributes.body: くらい (often ぐらい in speech) expresses an approximate degree or extent. It's often used with number + counter expressions (the くらい① form), as in 10分くらいかかった = 'It took about ten minutes.' ほど can be used similarly, but is more formal and carries the nuance of an upper limit—e.g., 10分ほど implies 'about, but no more than ten minutes.'

second_relatable.title: ほど
second_relatable.meaning: The more, About, To the extent that, So much… that

attributes.body: くらい (often ぐらい in speech) expresses an approximate degree or extent. A common use is with number + counter expressions, as in 10分くらいかかった ('It took about 10 minutes'). Unlike くらい, which can be used with durations or points in time (e.g. 10分くらい, 10時くらい), ごろ can only be used with points in time (e.g. 10時ごろ = 'around 10 o'clock').
